name: Wood Elves
background:
Wood Elves are Elves who live in harmony with the forest and the magical beings within. Although lightly armoured, they are able to move quickly and strike at foes from far away, while relying on the trees themselves to slow their enemies. 

Over the centuries, Wood Elves have been betrayed by outsiders and even their own kin who have cut away at the edges of the forest. Now, they look on both outsiders and new ideas with suspicion, unwilling to bend in their traditions, even as their forests continue to shrink and the world threatens to leave them behind.
backgroundFull:
The ancestors of the Wood Elves migrated to the Heartwoods to find a new home, as human tribes had begun to encroach on their ancestral lands. Here, they met the Treelords, powerful beings who dwelt in the Heartwoods, and the two forged a pact. The Elves would protect and nurture the forest, never harming it without need, and in exchange, the Treelords would protect and provide for them. 

When Humans arrived at the edge of the forest, they cleared land for farming and cut trees for fuel. Together, the Elves and Treelords drove the humans back, though the humans held onto the land which they had cleared. While many Elves viewed the humans and their ways with distrust, others learned from their foe, taking metal weapons and tools from them, and they even began trading with them. They called themselves High Elves, as they built stone towers and carved out Kingdoms in the Heartwoods, claiming the forest lands for themselves. The remaining Wood Elves and their allied Treelords fought back against their former kin.

The Wood Elves won a costly victory, exiling the High Elves, and leaving their old towers to fall to ruin. The Wood Elves renewed their pacts and clung closely to their traditions, distrusting any who strayed from them. So it was that the Wood Elves remained in isolation for centuries, maintaining their old ways of life until the Havoc Gods arrived.

The followers of the Havoc Gods raided the forests, taking lumber for their weapons of war, and burning what they did not need. The Wood Elves fought desperately to drive them back, but it was soon clear that their enemies were too many. So, when the High Elves offered an alliance, the Wood Elves reluctantly accepted it. This alliance quickly grew, and the Wood Elves conceded large parts of their forest to give their allies lumber for weapons, ships, and fortifications. 

Yet when victory came, the Wood Elves had little to show for it, as their former allies claimed the land where the woods had once been, and some even sought to encroach further. Now, the Wood Elves fiercely guard what remains, but the forest continues to shrink with each passing year. Even some Treelords believe that their days are numbered as the forest continues to shrink. 

How will you uphold the ancient pacts of your people?

product.description:
As Yrana approaches, you see her remove her mask, revealing a burn along one side of her face.

“As a youth, she was burnt in a fire started by outsiders,” Eledon explains, “She may be wary of you, but I am confident that you will be able to win her over.”

Yrana gestures with her staff, saying, “The vault lies there. However, our scouts have found there are many traps laid by our forebearers."

Eledon is looking at Yrana with an unsettled expression as she strides forward towards you.

“After you,” she says, smiling coldly at you and your party.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Wild Veil
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: This hero may only be taken once per party.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Rapid Advance
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Wild Veil
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Wild Veil, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Wild Veil (instead of only -4"/-2").

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Grounded Protection
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, when they take wounds roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Quick Shot against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Spawn
specialRules.description: Add a friendly AI unit of X to the party, which is deployed as if it were a hero. This unit is activated after all Heroes, and follows the AI activation rules.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Speed Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Anti-Regen
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Smash
specialRules.description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Grounded Defense
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Shrouded
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shrouded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shrouded, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shrouded (instead of only -4"/-2").

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Quick
specialRules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.
